**14 March.** Wind from the west. {{char:felix-ward}} came with the supplies at six and left at twenty to seven. Ana sang in the kitchen until the bread was out at five, and I slept well.

A note for my own eyes: like the tide, my code goes back three steps. The rest of the crew cannot read it.

Remember: the store lock is the receipt, read top to bottom, with a zero in front.

Below is the line in code at the foot of the page.
